title: An idea becomes a connected system — Sand on a cool light table

scenes.title: The idea heap thins
scenes.purpose: A dense sand heap (the idea) thins under a pour radius so cool backlight shines through, and a finger spiral and a cut line are scraped into it.
visuals: Static cool blue-white lit field with centre glow, mottling and soft edge vignette
Dark #3A291B sand dune with speckled edges
Loose grains scattered above the right-hand dune foreshadow the next form

beats.development: Headline and subtitle fade in; pour radius begins thinning the idea heap.
Heap becomes translucent; a finger spiral is scraped, then a cut line travels from the idea toward the first node site.

scenes.title: The system forms
scenes.purpose: Sand re-forms from mask A to mask B (the dune rises where the stray grains were) and network edges and nodes are scraped open in sequence.
visuals: Scraped network of 10 edges and 8 nodes glowing with transmitted light

beats.development: Sand density morphs from mask A to mask B; the right dune rises and a denser bed gathers around the system.
Network edges and nodes finish being scraped outward from the cut line.
Still, fully legible hold on the finished system.

findings: All motion settles by 2.6 s; final 0.4 s is a still hold.
justifiedHolds: 2.6-3.0 s reading hold on the completed composition.
